title: Lysergamides
disclaimer: Game catalog. No recipes. No doses. No how-to. Unitless 0-100 inferences from public reports. Unknown is null, never 0. Pleasure and compulsiveness are independent.

alias_validations.label: Orange Sunshine
alias_validations.note: 1973 defense claimed ALD-52. Sample tested LSD. Sand/Scully later said they never made ALD-52. Branding, not a molecule.

alias_validations.label: 1D-LSD bags
alias_validations.note: Japanese sheet labeled 1D was 1T on the instrument. Identity of a random 1D bag is uncertain.

punchiest_one_liners: The night that teaches you what a night is.
1P is the RC door. Same movie, legal envelope.
Acid that forgot to be sinister.
Same blotter. Different head. The visuals brought a lawyer.
They sold a morpholine and called it acid. It was not.
Orange Sunshine was a lawyer story.
You did not buy 1P. You bought ETH wearing a P.
gaps: No licensed human head-to-head of LSD vs 1P vs AL-LAD vs ETH-LAD with confirmed paper.
AL-LAD shorter vs Coney 2017 same-clock-as-a-group is unresolved. Do not invent hours.
1cP vs 1P hydrolysis speed in people is not a published number.
1D / 1T / 1S unique feel is unevidenced; 1D bags may be 1T.
1cP-AL-LAD / 1cP-MIPLA deacylation is expected, not proven in the forensic note.
PRO-LAD modern supply is contaminated by scam listings.
Dirty isomer blotters (iso-1P, cis-LSZ) confuse 'this analogue feels dirty.'
NBOMe-as-acid deaths will be blamed on LSD in NPC talk. Different kit.
Seed LSA reports are never pure ergine.
Later silicon / phosphoryl / ferrocene stickers: names on charts; no SKU without a seizure or a paper.
Blinded 1P / ALD-52 vs LSD still missing. Smoother come-up stays rumor.

substances.name: LSD

feel.headline: The night that teaches you what a night is.

rush.note: None. A slow door. Come-up energy is not a rush.

euphoria.note: Wonder, music, the grin. Not a roll. Not MDMA.

enjoyment.note: Gold-standard blotter. The want is the experience, not a binge.

compulsiveness.note: Low. Instant tolerance kills the encore. Fail-state is 'tab was weak.'

reinforcement.note: People chase the first time. Not a fiend loop.

paranoia.note: Anxiety and a heavy head if the room is wrong.

aftereffects.note: Next day can be flat or holy. Sleep is gone until it is over.

psychosis_concern.note: Real fail-state for the wrong brain, not the typical receipt.

cardiovascular.note: Mild tightness, not a stim heart story.

sleep.note: The night is the whole night.

substances.npc_line: The night that teaches you what a night is.
substances.notes: Deadly blotter story on this island is NBOMe sold as acid — different kit, same paper.

sources.title: Coney et al. Genie in a blotter (GDS 2016)

gaps: Street tabs are a lottery (underdosed, leftover 1P, NBOMe).

substances.npc_line: 1P is the RC door. Same movie, legal envelope.
substances.notes: Human oral/IV: parent gone, LSD remains. Weak 5-HT2A as the intact acyl. Dirty clone blotters are a quality roll, not a new feel.

substances.npc_line: Orange Sunshine was a lawyer story. The 2016 bottle is just LSD with a sticker.

substances.name: AL-LAD

feel.headline: Acid that forgot to be sinister.

rush.note: Still not a rush. Shulgin's people felt it fast sometimes. Fast is not a slam.

euphoria.note: Warmer, softer, more candy than LSD. Less mindfuck, more visual.

enjoyment.note: The analogue people actually ask for. N6-allyl. Not a prodrug.

compulsiveness.note: Low. Shorter-feeling nights in rumor make it less of a trap.

reinforcement.note: Want a second bottle. Not a binge.

paranoia.note: Friendlier than LSD. Bad rooms still happen.

aftereffects.note: Shorter rumor vs Coney 2017 same-clock. Unresolved.

substances.npc_line: Acid that forgot to be sinister.
substances.notes: Hoffman & Nichols 1985: full LSD substitution. Brandt Part II HTR. Dirty 1cP-AL-LAD copies later poisoned the well.

sources.title: Brandt et al. Return Part II (AL-LAD and LSZ)
Coney et al. 2017 GDS analogue survey

gaps: No modern controlled human vs LSD. Duration split unresolved.

compulsiveness.note: Low. People do not binge it. They remember it.

aftereffects.note: Still long-ish. Do not invent a clock.
